5056095706773.sourceDescription:
LZ pattern monofilament netting from the high quality Xnet range of Christmas tree netting by True Products. 
For use in manual or automatic netting machines. 

Used by growers and retailers to wrap trees securely for transportation without damaging tree branches.
Not only used for Christmas Trees but for all trees the year round. 

Also for filling barley straw into netting for use as an algae remover for lakes.
A sleeve of netting filled with barley straw is the perfect way of controlling blanketweed and ensuring crystal clear pond water. 
Not only is it effective, it's also completely natural. 

Barley straw naturally disrupts the development of each algae bloom and will destabilise blanket weed, so it can be removed through your pond filter.

Barley straw works by breaking down in pond water, producing a variety of chemicals that prevents the growth of algae. While these chemicals don't kill algae they send signals to the algae that tell it to stop growing, this is why barley staw is often called 'algae control' and not 'algae treatment' or 'algaecide'. 

To find out what size netting you require, measure the diameter of the small end of your tree netting funnel. 
The netting diameter closest to your measurement will be the one you need.

Sizes available:
LZ34 = 34cm diameter x 400m long sleeve of netting
LZ45 = 45cm diameter x 400m long sleeve of netting (THIS LISTING)
LZ55 = 55cm diameter x 400m long sleeve of netting

5058194838973.sourceDescription:
Christmas Baubles
Add colour and detail to your Christmas tree with these decorative baubles. Their hanging format lets you spread the ornaments through the branches or combine them with other suitable festive displays for a coordinated seasonal arrangement.

Shatter Resistant Design
The ornaments use a shatter resistant construction for the stated decorative use. They provide an alternative to traditional glass decorations when arranging the display, while retaining a defined shape and finish for the festive setting.

Striped Pattern
The striped pattern adds a clear repeating detail to the surface. It provides a decorative finish that can be paired with simpler surrounding colours.

Snowflake Detail
Snowflake detailing adds a winter themed accent to the design. The pattern can be used alongside simpler decorations to vary the visual texture of a seasonal arrangement while keeping the display within a coordinated festive theme.

Glitter Finish
The glitter finish adds a light catching detail to the surface. It brings a more textured appearance to the decorative arrangement and pairs well with plain finishes when you want the smaller design elements to remain visible.

Lightweight Design
The lightweight form is convenient to handle and move between suitable locations. It also makes the item easier to include when organising a bag or storage space.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Product details
Material: Plastic. Colour: Red and Gold. Stated size: 4 cm. Quantity: 50 pack.
Shatter resistant plastic construction provides a safe alternative to traditional glass ornaments for festive decorating.
Decorative striped pattern with snowflake detailing and glitter finish adds textured visual interest to Christmas trees.
Lightweight design ensures easy handling and convenient storage when not in use during the holiday season.
Includes a 50 pack of 4 cm red and gold baubles, offering ample quantity for full tree decoration.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Resistant to shattering
Included: 50 Christmas baubles
Hanger included

0086879861973.sourceDescription:
Product Type Door Mat / Floor Mat
Shape Round
Material Crystal Velvet
Design Printed Pattern
Features Non-Slip / Wear-Resistant / Moisture-Absorbing
Size Options 40×40cm(15.7x15.7inch) / 60×60cm (23.6x23.6inch)/ 80×80cm(31.5x31.5inch) / 100×100cm(39.3x39.3inch) / 120×120cm(47.2x47.2inch)
 Perfect For
 Front Door & Entrance — A soft welcome that keeps interiors clean
 Bedroom — Warm, cosy under bare feet every morning
 Garage — Durable and dirt-resistant, dust stops here
 Laundry Room — Absorbent and non-slip for wet-dry zones
 Patio — A versatile round mat for indoor and outdoor use
 Office — Comfort underfoot beside your workstation
 Hallways — Softness and safety with every step
 Care & Usage Tips
Before Use: Ensure the floor and the mat's underside are clean and dry for best grip
Daily Cleaning: Vacuum or brush regularly to remove loose dirt
Deep Cleaning: Wash with water where appropriate, or machine wash gently if suitable for your machine and the mat
Drying: Allow the mat to dry thoroughly before placing it back on the floor
Storage: Roll up and store in a dry place when not in use, away from heavy pressure
 Please Note
Please select your preferred size and design when ordering
Colours may vary slightly due to monitor settings; the actual product is the true reference
 Package Contents
 Round Non-Slip Door Mat × 1 (shipped in your selected size and design)
Crafted from crystal velvet with a soft, skin-friendly texture that's warm and cosy underfoot. More than a doormat — a soft landing that lets every homecoming begin in comfort.
The non-slip backing keeps the mat firmly positioned through daily traffic — no slipping or shifting underfoot. Extra peace of mind for every step through the door.
The absorbent surface quickly soaks up water and moisture tracked in from shoes and feet, keeping your floor dry and clean — no more trail of wet prints on rainy days.
Vacuum or brush for daily dust, rinse with water or machine wash where suitable — flexible cleaning that keeps it fresh and hygienic with minimal effort.
Unique printed patterns add a fashionable finishing touch, while the round shape suits any interior. Entryway, bedroom, garage, patio, office — beautiful wherever it goes.
Five sizes from 40×40cm to 120×120cm — from a compact doormat to a generous round rug, there's a size that's just right.

8956086363473.baseName: Christmas Tree Topper, Silver Glittered Hollow Tree Topper Star for Christmas Tree Ornament
8956086363473.variantName: Christmas Tree Topper, Silver Glittered Hollow Tree Topper Star for Christmas Tree Ornament
8956086363473.sourceDescription:
The silver version of the hollow star topper suits the white tree, the blue scheme and the household where gold is a step too warm. This one stands about 25 cm tall by 20 cm across, cut through so the fairy lights behind it shine out through the openings, and the silver glitter finish is treated to stay on through seasons of handling.

The cone column at the base fits onto the tree's tip more steadily than the flat-plate style, which is the detail that stops the annual wobble. It is sized for trees from about two metres upward, where the star reads at its best.

Thread a set of string lights through the hollows if the top of the tree deserves the full treatment, or let the tree's own lights do the work.

Material: Plastic with glitter
25 cm silver hollow star for tree tops
Open cut-work lets the fairy lights shine through
Glitter finish treated to survive handling
Cone column base steadier than flat plates
Fits trees from about two metres upward
For Indoor Use

5058194832773.sourceDescription:
Christmas Elf Decoration
This Christmas elf decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The red, white, and black finish and cotton construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Hanging Detail
The hanging detail provides a defined point for positioning or storage. Use a compatible support so the item can hang in its intended orientation.

Compact Format
The compact format helps the item fit into a smaller working or storage area. It is useful where you want the function close to hand without filling the whole space.

Reusable Design
The reusable format is intended to be used again after suitable care. Keep it clean and store it between uses so it remains ready for the next occasion.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Product details
Material: Cotton. Colour: Red, White, and Black. Stated size: 30 x 9 cm. Quantity: 5 piece set.
Includes a set of five festive cotton Christmas elf decorations for versatile holiday styling.
Features a convenient hanging detail, allowing for easy display on trees or as standalone ornaments.
Crafted from durable cotton in a classic red, white, and black colour scheme for timeless seasonal appeal.
Compact design measuring 30 x 9 cm, perfect for adding detailed charm without overwhelming your decor.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Included: 5 x Christmas elf decorations
Hanger included

Product Description

 This cream white knitted Christmas tree skirt is a wonderful festive decor for your holiday season. Made of thick, soft knitted polyester fabric, it adopts classic cable and diamond knit craftsmanship, delivering a warm, rustic and elegant look.


Specifications

 Colour: Cream White
 Material: Knitted Polyester
 Diameter: 48 in / 121.9 cm
 Closure: 3 fabric tie bows, side split opening
 Pattern: Cable knit & diamond pattern
 Package Includes: 1 × Christmas Tree Skirt

Notes

 Hand wash or gentle machine wash is recommended. Lay flat to dry; do not bleach.
 Please measure your tree stand before purchasing to check if the size meets your needs.
 Slight colour difference may exist due to different screen displays.
A BEAUTIFUL FINISH FOR YOUR CHRISTMAS TREE Bring your holiday decorations together with a cream white knitted Christmas tree skirt that makes the space beneath your tree feel warm and inviting. It helps conceal the tree stand and creates a beautiful backdrop for wrapped gifts, giving your Christmas centerpiece a complete, coordinated look. A cream tree skirt offers an inviting finishing touch for shoppers seeking an ivory tree skirt or christmas tree skirt ivory.
COZY KNIT TEXTURE, CHARMING DETAILS Inspired by a favorite winter sweater, the textured design combines cable knit accents with a decorative diamond border. These thoughtful details add depth and seasonal charm beneath your tree, complementing twinkling lights, festive ribbons and treasured ornaments. For those drawn to a white cable knit tree skirt, these textured details create a pretty tree skirt with cozy seasonal character.
EASY TO WRAP, BEAUTIFUL TO TIE Decorating your tree base is simple with an open slit that lets you wrap the skirt around the stand. Three pairs of matching ties bring the edges together and form charming bows, combining convenient setup with a decorative finishing touch. When choosing skirts for christmas tree displays, check the skirt diameter against your tree base. If you are searching for a christmas tree skirt 48 inches or a pencil tree skirt, confirm the product dimensions suit your setup before ordering.
ONE CREAM WHITE SKIRT, SO MANY HOLIDAY STYLES Create the Christmas look you love with a versatile neutral shade. Pair it with red and green for traditional holiday charm, gold and silver for an elegant display, or natural wood and muted colors for farmhouse, rustic, boho and Scandinavian-inspired Christmas decor. Style it as a rustic farmhouse christmas tree skirt or a trendy tree skirt to complement your holiday theme.
BRING CHRISTMAS CHARM TO EVERY DISPLAY Create a welcoming holiday focal point in your living room, bedroom, entryway or dining room, or add seasonal warmth to offices, boutiques and holiday party displays. Arrange wrapped presents around the tree base for a festive setting that makes gatherings and Christmas morning photos feel even more special. For shoppers comparing tree skirts, this xmas tree skirt adds a cozy decorative touch to festive spaces.

Benefits:
This tree skirt offers a simple yet effective way to complete your Christmas display while protecting your flooring. The generous diameter ensures it fits comfortably around most tree stands, while the soft polyester fabric provides a comfortable surface
 for gifts and feet alike. Whether you choose the classic red plaid with a drawstring for a snug fit or the charming snowman design with Velcro for quick adjustments, the skirt helps keep your space tidy by reducing visible mess. Its reusable nature

Ideal for use under real or artificial Christmas trees in living rooms, bedrooms or conservatories, this skirt adds a practical layer of protection and decoration. It can also be repurposed as a small seasonal rug or picnic blanket in the garden during

 of festive cheer to your UK home.
PERFECT 90CM TREE COVER-Provides full coverage for most standard Christmas trees, helping create a clean and decorative festive base while neatly framing wrapped gifts underneath. EASY FIXING OPTIONS FOR SECURE FIT-Designed with either a drawstring closure, allowing quick installation around the tree stand. Once secured, it stays in place throughout the festive season, even in busy family homes with children or pets.
DURABLE & REUSABLE POLYESTER FABRIC-Made from lightweight yet durable polyester fabric that is soft to touch and resistant to daily wear during the Christmas period. It can be folded flat for easy storage after use, making it a practical reusable decoration for many festive seasons.
FLOOR PROTECTION & PRACTICAL CLEANLINESS-Helps catch fallen pine needles, glitter and small debris from Christmas decorations, keeping carpets, laminate and wooden floors cleaner. Ideal for UK homes where trees are placed directly on living room flooring without additional mats.
FESTIVE HOME ATMOSPHERE DECORATION-Classic Christmas-inspired design enhances the overall look of your tree setup, making it suitable for modern apartments or traditional family homes. Works well with wrapped presents, fairy lights and seasonal ornaments for a complete festive display.
For Indoor Use

5096042276973.variantName: Christmas wreath - Festive door decoration - Pine cones and green metal hanger, hanging loop for doors and walls - PVC, 33 cm
5096042276973.sourceDescription:
This 33 cm PVC wreath comes with a hanging loop and a green metal door hanger measuring 29.5 cm. Pine cone details give the greenery depth, while the matching hanger keeps the hardware visually discreet.

A wreath puts the decoration on the door or wall itself, leaving the console or mantelpiece below free for cards and winter flowers. Its outline is complete in one piece, which is handy in an entrance where there is little space for a tree. Consider the drop of the hanger as well as the size of the wreath when choosing a door. Hold the two together before positioning them, so the arrangement sits comfortably between the upper panel and the handle.

From a few steps away the cones read as dark accents. Closer up, their overlapping scales contrast with the finer foliage. A simple ribbon or a nearby wooden decoration will pick up that woodland detail. For a simpler finish, keep additional decorations to one part of the ring and let the natural shape of the foliage show elsewhere.

When dressing an entrance, allow for the full movement of the door as well as the width of the decoration. Set it clear of the handle, letter plate and frame so the arrangement stays in position as people come and go. For an entrance used throughout the day, use a fixing suited to the door finish and the weight of the decoration. A trial positioning helps you check the view from both sides of an open door before committing to a spot.

After the festive season, lay the decoration in a box with space around its edges. Keep heavy ornaments and tightly coiled strings of lights separate so that the front of the wreath keeps its shape in storage. A plain background lets you see the smaller details even from the other side of the room. Try holding the wreath against a light wall and then against a darker door before fixing the hanging point.
Compact 33 cm PVC wreath with pine cone details for festive door or wall decoration.
Includes a discreet green metal hanger and hanging loop for easy installation.
Durable PVC construction maintains shape and withstands seasonal use.
Versatile design suitable for hanging on doors, walls, or mantelpieces.
Comes with Hanging loop and green metal door hanger
Hanging rope included

This Christmas wreath adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Glitter Finish
The glitter finish adds a light catching detail to the surface. It brings a more textured appearance to the decorative arrangement and pairs well with plain finishes when you want the smaller design elements to remain visible.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Features a sparkling glitter finish to add texture and light-catching detail.

Halloween Decoration
This Halloween decoration adds a decorative detail to the chosen display. The orange finish and fabric construction give it a defined appearance for Halloween.

Pumpkin Design
The pumpkin design gives the display a recognisable seasonal theme. Use it as a focal detail within an autumn or Halloween arrangement, pairing it with suitable surrounding decorations for a coordinated finish.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.
